name: Item randomizer
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Shuffles what the game gives out: the gadgets and weapons from NPCs and pickups, the vendor's weapons, the gold bolts and the infobots' coordinates, so each seed is a new route through the game. The placement follows what each place needs, so every seed can be finished. Share a seed's code and a friend plays the same game. A spoiler log of each seed is written to the mod's data folder. A save made with a seed belongs to that seed.

settings.name: Seed
settings.description: A seed code to play a shared game (it carries its settings), or any word. Blank: a random seed, rolled once and kept for your next starts (the log and the spoiler log show its code).

settings.name: Logic
settings.description: Standard: a gadget is placed only where you can get it without it, counting what each place uses. Relaxed: the same, with the gadgets early in the game and never in a gold bolt or an expensive purchase. Expert: only what a place cannot be done without counts.

settings.name: Shuffle gadgets
settings.description: The gadgets NPCs and pickups give: the Swingshot, the Heli-Pack, the Magneboots, ...

settings.name: Shuffle weapons
settings.description: The weapons NPCs and pickups give: the Suck Cannon, the Morph-o-Ray, the R.Y.N.O.

settings.name: Shuffle the vendor
settings.description: Each weapon the Gadgetron vendor sells is a slot that gives something else when bought, at the slot's price.

settings.name: Shuffle gold bolts
settings.description: Gold bolts join the pool: a gold bolt's place may hold a gadget, and a gold bolt may be anywhere.

settings.name: Shuffle infobots
settings.description: The planets' coordinates the infobots give join the pool.

settings.name: Keep the starting gear
settings.description: Start with the Bomb Glove, as the game does. Off: what Veldin gives at the start is shuffled too.

settings.name: Spoiler log
settings.description: Write where everything is, and a way through, to the mod's data folder.
